description: The file is a JavaScript/TypeScript script for analyzing source files within a project, specifically checking for the presence of certain plugin SDK subpaths in module imports and verifying their exports. It reads project configuration files, scans source files, and reports violations if certain subpaths are missing.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads 'package.json' to extract and return a set of plugin SDK subpaths that are exported.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads a JSON file to retrieve and return a set of plugin SDK entrypoints, excluding the 'index'.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Parses a module specifier string to extract the plugin SDK subpath if it starts with 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/'.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting violation entries based on file, line, kind, specifier, and subpath.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Asynchronously collects and returns a sorted list of violations where plugin SDK subpaths are missing from project exports or entrypoints.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that runs the violation collection, outputs results, or errors and exits accordingly.
